# Tax-Efficient Investing Skill for Muse

An in-depth manual for minimizing taxes on your investments: asset location by account type (bonds/REITs in IRA/401k, stocks in taxable), tax-loss harvesting with the wash-sale rule (61-day window, including your spouse's accounts), tax-lot selection (HIFO/FIFO/specific identification), Roth conversion breakeven analysis, RMD planning (SECURE 2.0, age 73), retirement withdrawal sequencing (taxable → deferred → Roth), and charitable strategies (donating appreciated stock, QCDs, donor-advised funds). Key formulas, fully worked numeric examples, common pitfalls — plus a Python module (`tax_efficiency.py`) with a `--verify` mode that validates the SKILL.md's own examples. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: US tax code only; advanced material — best for investors juggling several account types; the script needs Python plus numpy/scipy. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
